description: This file defines the interface for an AAC encoder, including configuration structures, function prototypes for initializing, encoding, and closing the encoder, and related data structures.

methods.name: AacInitDefaultConfig
methods.description: Provides a default configuration for the AAC encoder.

methods.name: AacEncOpen
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new AAC encoder instance.

methods.name: AacEncEncode
methods.description: Encodes audio data using the AAC encoder.

methods.name: AacEncClose
methods.description: Deallocates and closes the AAC encoder instance.
